+import argparse
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Print Hello, NAME! with optional times.')
+    parser.add_argument('--name', required=True, help='Name to greet.')
+    parser.add_argument('--times', type=int, default=1, help='Number of times to print (default: 1).')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    
+    if args.times <= 0:
+        print("Error: --times must be a positive integer.")
+        exit(1)
+    
+    for _ in range(args.times):
+        print(f"Hello, {args.name}!")
+

+    main()
